Container.Name: signerd
Container.Overview: YubiKey-backed Authenticode signer (golift/codesign). Put this container on the same Docker network as your reverse proxy so nginx can proxy_pass to http://signerd:8750. Extra Parameters already publish 127.0.0.1:8750 for operator SSH tunnels; do not publish 0.0.0.0. Pass only the YubiKey CCID device (VID 1050). Bus and device numbers change on reboot; never pass a whole USB bus (on unRAID that includes the boot flash). Privileged is not required. PIN and cert chain live under /config, not in git. See docs/docker-usb.md.

Config.Name: appdata
Config.Description: chain.pem plus an optional pin file (chmod 0600). Container Path: /config

Config.Name: YubiKey CCID
Config.Description: lsusb -d 1050: then /dev/bus/usb/BBB/DDD. Numbers change on reboot/replug. Never the unRAID boot flash.

Config.Name: Listen
Config.Description: Container listen address. Host publish is loopback-only via Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: PIN file
Config.Description: PIV user PIN, one line. chmod 0600. Never the PUK.

Config.Name: OIDC audience
Config.Description: Must match the public sign URL GitHub Actions request tokens for.

Config.Name: Allowlisted repo
Config.Description: Owner/repo allowed to sign. Empty allowlist signs nothing remotely. Add _1, _2, ... for more repos.
